method: Correções pontuais após inspeção em resolução original

jobs.edit: REBUILD ONLY FOLHA and his two arms. Current picture wrongly puts BOTH arms on the visible right side and a face on a narrow edge. Make a TRUE REAR VIEW of an OPEN BOOK, like the coherent two indigo cover panels and central spine of image 2; no face is visible from this back view. Rotate the entire open book diagonally about 20 degrees and float it in the lower-left, cap and mint bookmark consistent. Both arms begin BEHIND the two opposite OUTER cover edges at MID HEIGHT, with their roots fully hidden by the cover panels. LEFT arm emerges only OUTSIDE the LEFT silhouette, sweeping upward to one small cream mitten above-left of the cap. RIGHT arm emerges only OUTSIDE the RIGHT silhouette, sweeping upward to the other small cream mitten above-right of the cap. The two hands have just RELEASED the origami bird toward upper-right; neither holds it. No arms both on same side, no socket on indigo back panels, no root near top edge, no face on paper thickness. Preserve paper bird, sprout pot, room light, BRONZE FRAME and blank ribbon.

The long indigo bar crossing the face currently ENDS in a rounded wrong root ON THE CREAM PAGE around x=835,y=640. Completely REMOVE that wrong arm and restore the cream page under it. Simplify the action naturally: only the nearer LEFT hand pulls the gold machine lever, from a thin arm emerging BEHIND the far LEFT cover edge. That left root must be hidden by the cover silhouette, no page socket. The OTHER RIGHT arm comes from BEHIND the OUTERMOST RIGHT cover edge at mid-height, appears OUTSIDE that right contour and bends DOWN toward ONE small cream mitten placing a BLANK checked card on the lower-right machine platform. Do not draw that arm across face; keep its entire exposed curve to the RIGHT of the book. Move this card/hand inward slightly if needed to stay inside circular scene. Retain the open book's strained wink/teeth effort expression, whole-body backward lean and correct two page planes/gutter. No hand on the cap. Preserve conveyor, lever, all machinery and SAPPHIRE FRAME unchanged. Exactly two hands, one lever hand and one card hand.

Two precise repairs only. FIRST: the writing arm has a rounded endpoint visibly stuck on the indigo cover plane near (570,510). Repaint the indigo book cover ON TOP OF this endpoint and all arm pixels inside the cover boundary (roughly x=550..605,y=480..565). Retain the exposed indigo limb only OUTSIDE the left silhouette, beginning just beyond the outer edge near (535,550) and continuing to the existing quill hand. The cover edge must overlap/occlude the hidden root, not a socket on its surface. No rounded endpoint on the cover. Keep the good open-book geometry, quill hand, quill, stamp hand, desk and lighting. SECOND: remove the SMALL EXTRA GOLD TASSEL hanging at the upper-left book edge beside the mint bookmark; preserve ONLY the single large gold tassel on the RIGHT of its graduation cap. Repair pages/cap underneath the removed extra tassel. Preserve the complete RUBY FRAME and blank ribbon unchanged; two arms/hands, one cap tassel.

REBUILD BOTH ARM GESTURES, keeping the book open and its awed 'o' expression looking down at three flames. REMOVE the entire cheek-propping arm with its wrong rounded blue root on the cream page and REMOVE that cheek hand; restore the cream paper and cover cleanly. LEFT hand now rests on the DESK to the LEFT of the book, palm down, reached by a short thin indigo arm emerging BEHIND the far LEFT cover edge at mid-height; cover hides the root, exposed curve entirely OUTSIDE left book contour. RIGHT hand still points at the three flames but its arm must come BEHIND the far RIGHT cover edge at mid-height, with a short exposed segment entirely OUTSIDE the right book contour. No cheek-touching hand, no rounded root or socket anywhere on cream page or indigo back-cover plane. Keep the whole book diagonally leaning down toward the tray, two broad cream inner pages and central gutter, cap/bookmark, copper tray with exactly three flames, library light, BRONZE FRAME and empty ribbon. Do not add legs, human torso or realistic forearms.
